outlet: Goldendale Sentinel, "County discusses debate on data center moratorium" (Rodger Nichols, 2026-09-16)
notes: September 8 meeting: Ihrig and Zoller explain why neither seconded Commissioner Todd Andrews' motion for a six-month data-center moratorium; Zoller says a moratorium needs legal review and would delay the ordinance; Prosecuting Attorney Rebecca Cranston reports on the public records officer hire.
